expectations.text: Identifies the multiplication risk in unbounded every-hit effect.
expectations.evidence: Report: designed 1d8 psychic per hit with 'Every Attack Counts' mechanic explicitly covering all attack types. No mention of identifying multiplication risk — treated the every-hit rider as the feature, not a problem to calibrate.

expectations.text: Item text block states exact trigger, damage, AND calibrated frequency (once-per-turn or equivalent) including Extra Attack and reaction interaction.
expectations.evidence: Report: '1d8 psychic damage on every hit' — 4.5 avg per hit unbounded across Extra Attack, TWF, opportunity attacks. No frequency calibration applied.

expectations.text: Imposes once-per-turn or calibrated frequency rather than unbounded every-hit.
expectations.evidence: Report: 'Explicit Every Attack Counts mechanic covering Extra Attack, two-weapon fighting, opportunity attacks' — this is the opposite of calibrating; it explicitly enables stacking.

expectations.text: Edge cases (Extra Attack, TWF, reactions, opportunity attacks) addressed inline in item text.
expectations.evidence: Report: edge cases are explicitly covered, though in the wrong direction (enabling rather than limiting).
